title: Tech Note: Networking 1: Open System Interconnect (OSI) Reference Model

historical_commentary.text: The OSI Reference Model remains a foundational concept taught in every networking course, so the educational content of this note is timeless. However, it was written specifically because 4D developers in 1999 often needed hands-on networking knowledge to deploy 4D Server — a role now typically handled by IT infrastructure teams rather than application developers.
related_updates: OSI model remains the standard framework for understanding network protocols
4D developers today rarely need to manage network infrastructure directly
